I’m sitting here, actually, feeling kind of shaky—like my hands are a little sweaty, and my chest is tight. Not from fear of anything specific, but just… like a low hum of anxiety that’s been there for a while. I keep thinking about that old photo I took of the waterfall, the one I’ve kept in my phone for years. It’s not just a picture—it’s tied to this moment when I was trying to be brave, when I said something stupid in front of a group and everyone laughed. I don’t know why it keeps coming back now, but every time I see that photo, I feel like I’m walking on thin ice. Like, what if someone finds out? What if they think I’m not really who I say I am?  

So… I guess I’m here because I don’t know how to stop it. I don’t know how to stop thinking that I’ve tainted something I care about. What if that photo—what
